weapon.d: Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1). At start of turn, if unit is within 3 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Def+6 and "unit can move to a space adjacent to any ally within 2 spaces" to unit and allies within 3 spaces of unit for 1 turn. At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 to unit, unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack, and neutralizes effects that grant "Special cooldown charge +X" to foe or inflict "Special cooldown charge -X" on unit during combat.

special.d: Boosts damage by 30% of unit's Atk.
Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Atk.
